cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Outsmart the Room
cards.instruction: Turn every clue, deduction, and secret into a contest you must solve or control first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll settle the quiz murder now. I've put 'the gardener' above your answer on the board.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine, one answer on the slip. But who said it first?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My chalk reached the board first. I'll write both our names; mine goes on top.

reason: Ground the shared conclusion in a quiz and give A a cooperative submission concession, while each tie makes A redefine the race toward chalk timing and name order.
